- Use Go as the language (Hyperledger Fabric standard).
- Follow existing API patterns in the configtx package.
- Combine or separate genesis block creation functions based on existing encoder patterns (will separate for clarity).
- Extend SigningIdentity interface to include both SignConfigUpdate and SignConfigUpdateEnvelope.
